Hello! I am **Wei Wang** (Vino), a PhD student in Learning, Design, and Technology at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville. I study how ICT and generative AI can support meaningful learning, assessment, and instructional design in higher education.

## Research focus

- GenAI integration in teaching and learning
- Educational data science and large-scale assessment
- Evaluation methods for technology-enabled learning

## Recent work

- Co-founding [**Ask About EDU (AAU)**](Projects/Ask_About_EDU/Ask_About_EDU.qmd), an evidence-informed decision-support platform that helps educators access, interpret, and apply verified educational research. Company formation is currently in progress.
- Co-leading the [**Next Level Teaching Blueprint**](Projects/Next_Level_Teaching_Blueprint/Next_Level_Teaching_Blueprint.qmd) as Student PI and Graduate Researcher, examining how constraint-first, dialogic AI activities can strengthen critical thinking in research methods courses.
- Leading the forthcoming CRC Press book [*Computational Analysis of Educational Data: A Field Guide Using R*](Publications/Computational_Analysis_Educational_Data/Book.qmd) as first author (expected late 2026).
- Building tools and visualizations for large educational datasets in R and Python.
- Translating research into practical guidance for instructors and students.

I believe in the motto: **"Technology comes and goes, pedagogy never falls."** This guides my work toward grounded, human-centered learning experiences.
